entry.title: New: Bill 97, CD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND HUMAN CONCERNS" The purpose of this bill is to add a new grant under the Department of Housing and Human Concerns entitled "American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 - Emergency Rental Assistance Program #2 (ERA #2)" in the amount of $322,248.
